task: Generate 2,000 sales orders, analyse them, build a dark analytics dashboard, check it in a browser. Then, mid-run: add a region filter.

steps.title: Type the brief
steps.detail: We type a five-part brief into the live web chat: make the data, analyse it, build the dashboard to an exact colour spec, test it in a browser, report the numbers.

steps.title: Its own sealed box
steps.detail: Sending starts a session. It gets its own gVisor box on the Vultr worker: no keys inside, no route to private networks. GLM 5.3 Flash on Vultr Serverless Inference plans the first step.

steps.title: Write three programs
steps.detail: One shell command writes generate.py (2,000 seeded orders), analyze.py (pandas totals into summary.json) and app.py (a Flask page with Chart.js), then runs all three.

steps.title: Fix a missing library
steps.detail: The numbers are ready: $6,414,795 from 2,000 orders. But the web server didn't start: Flask isn't installed. It installs it, restarts, and checks the page has the total and Jan to Dec.

steps.title: Check in a real browser
steps.detail: It opens the page in Chromium inside the box, reads the four KPI cards back off the page, compares them with summary.json, and saves a screenshot.

steps.title: We steer it mid-run
steps.detail: While it works we type a second message: add a region filter. It reaches the agent before its next step. No restart: same box, same files.

steps.title: Answer, then keep going
steps.detail: It posts the first answer and screenshot, then takes on the new request: it computes West's totals straight from the CSV with pandas, as a reference to test against.

steps.title: Rewrite the page
steps.detail: It adds per-region data to summary.json and patches app.py: a dropdown, filtered cards, chart and table, and a brighter bar for the chosen region. It checks the code parses and restarts.

steps.title: Use the new filter
steps.detail: Back in the browser it picks West. Its first try passes a CSS selector where the tool wants a numbered ref, so it takes a snapshot, selects again, and reads the cards back.

steps.title: Prove the numbers
steps.detail: A screenshot of the West view, then an independent pandas check on the CSV: 489 orders, $1,480,535, average $3,027.68. The page matches exactly.

steps.title: Done
steps.detail: 45 seconds of agent time, 24 tool calls, 26 model calls on Vultr: $0.011. Both screenshots come back in the chat; the files stay in the box to download.

results.label: THE RESULT  ·  THE AGENT'S OWN SCREENSHOT
results.caption: All regions: $6,414,795 from 2,000 orders, months in calendar order.

results.label: AFTER THE MID-RUN MESSAGE
results.caption: West selected: cards, monthly chart and table filtered; the West bar highlighted.
